description: Live 4-stage enrichment for 1–25 unique domains per call: detects ecommerce platforms & marketing/support/pixel stack (Shopify, WooCommerce, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Recharge, Meta/TikTok Pixel, GA4), samples public Shopify /products.json catalog counts & native-currency min/median/max prices, scores 1.0–5.0 ICP prospect fit + active-merchant check + wholesale/B2B signal, and extracts public same-domain role emails (hello@, sales@) & social URLs. Pass multiple domains together in one array rather than calling 1 domain at a time. Paid mode (via HTTP header Authorization: Bearer zsk_live_... or X-API-Key) debits 1 credit per reachable billable domain ($0 for DNS/TLS/timeout/5xx/429/WAF failures), enables calibrated AI ICP scoring, and returns a durable job_id recoverable via get_inspection_results.

b2b_wholesale_only.description: Optional filter: return only domains with detected B2B, trade, or wholesale signals.

oneOf.description: Array of 1 to 25 domains or URLs (batch multiple domains together in a single call).
Newline- or comma-separated list of 1 to 25 domains or URLs.

min_fit_score.description: Optional filter: minimum 1.0–5.0 ICP prospect fit score (e.g. 3.5 or 4.0).

platform.description: Optional filter: match primary platform or detected tech (e.g. "Shopify", "WooCommerce", "Klaviyo").

real_merchant_only.description: Optional filter: return only verified active merchants/operators (excludes parked/empty stores).
